lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 오늘 환율 뉴스 봤어요? 또 올랐대요.
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, did you see the exchange rate news? It went up again.
lines.beaver_roman: Minsu ssi, oneul hwanyul nyuseu bwasseoyo? Tto ollatdaeyo.
lines.learner: 네, 봤어요. 달러를 미리 바꿔 둘걸 그랬어요.
lines.en: Yes, I did. I should have exchanged dollars earlier.
lines.roman: Ne, bwasseoyo. Dalleoreul miri bakkwo dulkkeol geuraesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Why? Are you traveling next month?
lines.learner: 네, 다음 달에 미국에 가요. 시기가 안 좋네요.
lines.en: Yes, I'm going to the US next month. Bad timing.
lines.roman: Ne, daeum dare miguge gayo. Sigiga an jonneyo.

lines.learner: 네, 수입 과일 값이 많이 올랐어요.
lines.en: Yes, imported fruit got a lot more expensive.
lines.roman: Ne, suip gwail gapsi mani ollasseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: When the exchange rate rises, imports get pricier.
lines.en: Prices at the supermarket all went up too.

lines.beaver: 그래도 수출하는 회사는 좋을 수도 있어요.
lines.beaver_roman: Geuraedo suchulhaneun hoesaneun joeul ssudo isseoyo.
lines.en: Right. Every company's situation must be different.

lines.beaver: 주식은 어때요? 민수 씨도 주식 있잖아요.
lines.beaver_en: How about stocks? You have some too, don't you?
lines.beaver_roman: Jusigeun eottaeyo? Minsu ssido jusik itjanayo.
lines.en: The economy is bad, so my stocks fell too.

lines.beaver_en: What about gold? I heard it went up a lot lately.
lines.learner: 네, 금이나 은을 사 둘걸 그랬어요.
lines.en: Yes, I should have bought some gold or silver.
lines.roman: Ne, geumina euneul sa dulkkeol geuraesseoyo.

lines.beaver: 사람들은 경기가 나쁘면 금을 많이 사요.
lines.beaver_en: People buy a lot of gold when the economy is bad.
lines.beaver_roman: Saramdeureun gyeonggiga nappeumyeon geumeul mani sayo.
lines.en: Because gold is safe when currency value drops.

lines.beaver_en: What do you think will happen to the economy?
lines.learner: 글쎄요. 경제 공부를 미리 할걸 그랬어요.
lines.en: Well. I should have studied economics earlier.
lines.roman: Geulsseyo. Gyeongje gongbureul miri halkkeol geuraesseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: It's lunchtime anyway, so let's talk over coffee.
lines.en: Great. I'll buy the coffee this time.
